title: 10Base2

## 10Base2 (Thin Ethernet)

A **thin coaxial cable** (maximum 185 m) snakes from a cable-end cap, up through stations (each
tapped on via small diamond T-connectors). Unlike 10Base5's
straight bus with drop cables, 10Base2 stations connect directly
in-line on the thin coax via T-connectors.
